howToFill: For each scene put 'pass' / 'fail' / 'n/a' against the four criteria after LOOKING across its sampled frames. 'fail' remains a quality failure; "resolved": true records acknowledged/accepted quality debt and does not turn it into a pass.

criteria.illustrated: narration is shown, not left to the viewer's imagination
criteria.composed: balanced, everything inside the frame and legible
criteria.varied: not the same visual formula as its neighbours
criteria.purposeful: every element is there for a reason, not filler
